name: Green Swamp West Tract: Ashley, Cumpressco and McNeil campgrounds (Southwest Florida Water Management District)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: 13347 Ranch Road, Dade City, FL 33525 (main gate; Cumpressco and McNeil entrances are off SR 471)
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Ashley and Cumpressco are equestrian/primitive campgrounds and McNeil is primitive only, all with picnic tables and fire rings, on the eastern edge of Pasco County just south of the Richloam Tract. From US 301 in Dade City follow River Road east five miles to the main gate. The map point is OpenStreetMap's marker for the Green Swamp preserve, not a campsite, so navigate by the address and the gate named on your reservation.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: 7 consecutive days, 30 days per calendar year Ashley and Cumpressco are closed for hunts Nov 13-16, Dec 3-8 and Dec 15-20, 2026. The page says the tract is open year-round 'except during the special opportunity archery, general gun, hog-still and turkey seasons'. Portable toilets and nonpotable water at the campgrounds.

conditions.summary: Ashley and Cumpressco open Nov 17 - Dec 2, closed Dec 3-8. McNeil was listed closed for flooding Nov 3-18; check that it reopened. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
